dct_description_sm: Atlas based on author's pilgrimage to the Holy Land during 1483-1484.
Title and imprint supplied by cataloger; author name from frontispiece; edition statement from pencil inscription on page [3].
Title translation: Pilgrimage to the Holy Land.
First 4 and last 4 pages blank (included in page description).
Color in last two leaves of plates and fifth foldout map.
Map of Jerusalem includes points of interest for Christian pilgrims, including Mount Sinai, Temple of Soloman (i.e., Mosque of Omar) and Church of Holy Sepulchre.
Map 1. Civitas Veneciaru -- Map 2. Parens -- Map 3. Corevn -- Map 4. Modon -- Map 5. [Rhodes] -- Map 6. Candia -- Map 7. Civitas Iherusalem
Bernhard von Breydenbach and his journey to the Holy Land 1483-4: A bibliography compiled by Hugh Wm. Davies, published by J. & J. Leighton, London, 1911, xviii-xxiv.
A descriptive catalogue of books, in the library of John Holmes, F. S. A. with notices of authors & printers. Vol. II, 17.
This copy contains book plate on front cover, inside: "Bateman of Middleton Hall (by Youlgrave) in the County of Derby".
Inscriptions on pages [2]: 41; [3]: 1502; and verso of title page (... a complete copy of the 1502 ed.).
This copy has hole punch in lower right corner from first pages through first foldout map.
